enhance-video.title: Video quality enhancement
enhance-video.summary: To programmatically improve video quality, you can use this API to submit an asynchronous enhancement task. It leverages AI algorithms to perform a series of optimizations, including denoising, color enhancement, artifact removal, and super-resolution.

params.name: video_url
params.description: The URL of the video to be enhanced. * Video source: Only publicly accessible HTTP/HTTPS URLs are supported. * Supported formats: Mainstream video formats such as `mp4`, `flv`, `ts`, `avi`, `mov`, `wmv`, `mkv`. * File size: It is recommended that the size of a single input file not exceed 10 GB. * Video resolution: Supports up to 2K.

params.name: tool_version
params.description: The tool version determines the strength and scope of the enhancement algorithms and the billing. * `standard`: (Default) Standard version. Balances processing speed and video quality, includes over 10 frequently used enhancement algorithms, and meets the quality requirements of mainstream playback platforms. Suitable for quality improvement in video distribution scenarios. * `professional`: Professional version. Provides professional-grade quality enhancement with over 30 built-in algorithms, ensuring shot-level visual effects. Suitable for cinema-grade video production. For details, see Vers

params.name: scene
params.description: The video enhancement scenario, which only takes effect when `tool_version` is `standard`. Used to select a preset enhancement template for a specific business scenario. Possible values: * `common`: (Default) General-purpose template. * `ugc`: UGC (User-Generated Content) short video scenario. * `short_series`: Short-form drama series scenario. * `aigc`: AIGC (AI-Generated Content) scenario. * `old_film`: Old film restoration scenario. For details, see Versions and scenes.

params.name: enhance_style
params.description: The video enhancement style. Supported by both the Standard and Professional versions. * `hd`: (Default) High definition. Offers moderate enhancement for a sharp and clear image. * `natural`: Natural look. Reduces enhancement strength for fewer sharpening artifacts and a more natural-looking picture. For details, see Configure enhancement style.

params.name: resolution

Note: This parameter is mutually exclusive with `resolution_limit` and cannot be configured at the same time.

params.name: resolution_limit
params.description: The pixel limit for the short side of the target resolution, with a value range of `[128, 4320]`. The system will scale the video proportionally to this limit while maintaining the original aspect ratio. Note: This parameter is mutually exclusive with `resolution` and cannot be configured at the same time.

params.name: bitrate_level
params.description: The target bitrate level, used to control the average bitrate of the output video. This parameter affects the visual quality and final file size of the video. For the specific bitrates for each level, refer to Bitrate reference. If you need to specify a precise bitrate, use the `bitrate` parameter.

params.description: The target average bitrate, in kbps. The value must be within the range of [10, 150000]. params.name: face_box_expand

extract-frames.summary: This API submits an asynchronous frame extraction task. Based on your business scenario, you can choose one of four strategies—by time interval, by specified time points, by specified frames (first/last) , or by scene change—to capture one or more still images from a video. params.name: video_url
params.description: The URL of the video to be processed. * Video source: Only publicly accessible HTTP/HTTPS URLs are supported. * Supported formats: Mainstream video formats such as `mp4`, `flv`, `ts`, `avi`, `mov`, `wmv`, `mkv`.

params.description: The frame-extraction strategy, which determines how frames are captured. Defaults to `TimeInterval`. * `TimeInterval`: Extract frames at a fixed time interval; used together with `time_interval`. * `SpecifiedTime`: Extract frames at specified time points; used together with `specified_time`. * `SpecifiedFrames`: Extract frames at specified frame numbers; used together with `specified_frames`. * `SceneChange`: Extract frames on scene changes; used together with `scene_change_threshold`.
